description: Models homotopy pullbacks by pairs of points together with paths between their images. The pullback of a point with itself over a circle recovers its loop space and winding numbers; homotopy fibers, equalizers, coherent cones, and a circle-shaped homotopy pushout explain why ordinary limits can discard essential homotopy data.
